title: Paste clipboard contents to the terminal
summary: Use xsel to print the current contents of the system clipboard directly to your terminal. This is helpful for viewing what is currently copied without opening a text editor.

steps.explain: Run xsel with the output and clipboard flags to print the clipboard contents to the terminal.

alternatives.explain: Save the clipboard contents directly to a file instead of printing to the terminal.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file where you want to save the clipboard contents.
